title: RocketWiki chart values
description: Deliberately narrow: this schema exists to hard-fail the values that would corrupt or silently break the system (design.md §15), not to re-type every knob. Draft-07 so both Helm 3 and Helm 4 enforce it.

replicaCount.description: Locked to exactly 1. design.md §15: SignalR presence/notification fan-out is per-process in-memory state; >1 replica needs a Redis backplane (a deliberate future decision, not a values knob) and would also demand this guard's removal. The api-deployment.yaml template repeats this check for anyone who edits the schema away.

existingSecret.description: Name of the operator-created Secret carrying connection strings and S3 credentials. Required: this chart never templates secret material.

instanceId.description: design.md §12: this deployment's instance identity, and REQUIRED. It used to default to "", which omitted the env var and let the app's "standalone" fallback apply — so a low/high pair installed from this chart with defaults both called themselves "standalone", every imported space satisfied OriginInstanceId == localInstanceId, IsReplicaOf was false, and every mirrored space was writable on the high side. A silent fail-OPEN on the one invariant one-way sync rests on. Must be distinct per instance; a standalone deployment can say "standalone" explicitly, which is a decision rather than a default.

mode.description: "http" (default) wires /alive to liveness and /health to readiness and sets HealthEndpoints__Enabled on the api container (the app-side opt-in; the endpoints stay unrouted at the ingress). "tcp" is the dependency-free fallback - see values.yaml.

provider.description: Matches RocketWiki.Storage's AddFileStorage, which fails closed on anything else. SqlServer stores blobs in the database — see values.yaml for why it is not the default.

oidcAuthority.description: REQUIRED. The Keycloak realm URL the web image was built with (--build-arg VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY). Pattern-checked rather than merely non-empty because readOidcConfig rejects anything that is not an http(s) URL and disables sign-in, so a typo ships the same unusable image as an omission - and because the chart derives the CSP's connect-src from this value's ORIGIN, which a scheme-less string has none of. The web image build refuses the same two cases (Dockerfile.web's oidc-authority-check stage); this is the deployment-side half of the same rule.

connectSrc.description: Content-Security-Policy connect-src OVERRIDE. Empty (the default) means derive `'self' <origin of web.oidcAuthority>`, which is what sign-in needs and nothing more - so the common deployment states the authority once and the policy follows. Empty is therefore legal here, unlike frameSrc: it never reaches the header as an empty directive, because the derivation always produces both terms and the template fails the render if it cannot. Set this only to add MORE origins (an OTLP collector, a second IdP); you then own the whole list, Keycloak origin included.

frameSrc.description: Content-Security-Policy frame-src. minLength 1 because there is nothing to derive it from and an EMPTY string would substitute into the policy as `frame-src ;` - which browsers read as an empty source list, i.e. the same as 'none' but by accident rather than decision. Say "'none'" (the default) to forbid frames, never "". Must name the draw.io origin the image was built against (VITE_DRAWIO_URL) if the diagram editor is enabled.
